title: clopen_last_four
statement:
theorem clopen_last_four (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsClosed (U i : Set X))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (U i : Set X) (U j)))
    (hcov : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (H : ∀ i, Assertions Λ ((U i).ι ≫ f)
      ((constantSheaf (U i).toScheme.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    FiniteOfIsProper Λ f ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M) ∧
    BaseChangeOfInvertibleOrder Λ f ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M) ∧
    BaseChangeOfIsProper Λ f ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M) ∧
    SurjectiveRestrictionTwo Λ ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)

source.place: Proof, first paragraph: finite disjoint unions commute with every map under consideration

proof.text: Use Mathlib nonempty_isColimit_cofanMk_of to realize the disjoint covering opens as a scheme coproduct. Identify the underlying abelian constant module sheaf with the constant abelian sheaf by Mathlib constantCommuteCompose, then identify its restrictions with the corresponding constant sheaves by upperStarConstantSheafIso. FiniteCoproductCohomologyAssembly identifies global cohomology with the finite product of restricted cohomologies.

For an arbitrary morphism g:Y→X, pull back each open inclusion. Scheme.Pullback.range_fst identifies the component images with preimages of the original opens, so they are a disjoint cover of Y and again a scheme coproduct. Cohomology pullback composition, together with pullback.condition, identifies the restriction of g* with the product of the component comparison maps. Prove in Lean that componentwise surjectivity implies global surjectivity by choosing component preimages and assembling them; prove injectivity by restricting, using component injectivity and cancelling the composition isomorphisms.

For C5, closed open immersions are closed immersions by IsClosedImmersion.of_isOpenImmersion, hence proper. Therefore each restricted structure morphism is proper. Constructibility pulls back and transfers to the component constant sheaf through its canonical isomorphism. Apply the C5 field of each H i, transfer finiteness through the restriction isomorphism, and use finiteness of the indexed product and injectivity of the coproduct restriction map.

For C6, preserve invertible-order torsion under pullback via upperStarCompSheafFiberIso and under coefficient isomorphism via its stalk linear equivalence. Paste the pullback square of each open inclusion with the given field-extension square, obtaining the component field-extension square. Apply each H i C6. The proved comparison_conjugate identity identifies the comparison map with the component map conjugated by cohomology equivalences; rewrite by it and apply generic Equiv.bijective and Function.Bijective.comp. For C7, use the properness of the component structure morphisms and the same pasted squares to apply each H i C7. The componentwise bijectivity criterion gives both global comparisons. For C8, pull back the open immersion to each component, apply each H i C8, rewrite the same conjugation identity, apply generic Equiv.surjective and Function.Surjective.comp, and use the componentwise surjectivity criterion.
